Chord Entry

Play the chords of a tune on a MIDI keyboard (or click them on the keys below) and they are written out as a chart. Check it, then send it to the Backing Track page, where the band plays it.

1. Set up

2. Enter

ms

3. Check

4. Send it on

The ABC holds the chords, key, meter and title. The style, the tempo and any voicings you played in are not part of ABC: they travel only with "Open in the Backing Track".
